clips.title: The story
paras: In the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, Forsaken warlocks seek to summon, conquer, and permanently command a voidwalker. Carendin Halgar oversees the rite that grants them this power.

Forsaken warlocks must prove they can master a voidwalker before they may summon one. Unlike minor imps, which dark magic easily draws into pacts, creatures of the Void despise reality and possess formidable physical might. In the Magic Quarter, mentor Carendin Halgar provides the mystic runes required to tear a voidwalker from the Nether into the physical realm.

Beneath Carendin Halgar's dais, a glowing summoning circle is etched into the floor. When the runes are activated, an unbound voidwalker appears in fury. You cannot subdue it through diplomacy; you must break it with arcane force and raw will. Only after the creature is thoroughly crushed does Carendin reveal the true summoning formula, which binds its essence to you indefinitely.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Surely you have seen the circle of summoning below us? Only there will you be able to draw forth an unbound voidwalker.
Using these runes, you will be able to draw it forth, and then you must dominate it through strength of arms and magic.
When it is subdued, it will be indentured to you. Come to me then, and I will elucidate the spell of summoning, so that it may serve you to whatever end you wish.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I expect to hear of your success, friend. Not meeting my expectations will be the least of your worries, however, should you fail.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend. Now, I will impart to you the spell used for summoning the voidwalker.
The power that it unleashed upon you is now yours to command. Use it wisely.
